performance.verdict: Paid ads fully dark 28+ days; organic holding but contract unresolved.

findings.text: Zero paid spend and zero leads for all 28 days in window — $0 Meta, $0 Google. No revenue-generating activity exists.
Extension with Marwan unsigned as of 2026-08-31 deadline — contract lapse blocks next 3-month scope and all paid reactivation.
SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31 — contact-rate bottleneck identified in July remains unresolved.
GBP actions collapsed -96.61% week-over-week; last 3 days show 0 actions vs prior-3-day average of ~2.3 — local visibility effectively dead.
Search clicks held steady (~34–44/day last 3 days vs 26–43 prior 3), and GA4 sessions averaging ~66 — organic SEO the sole live traffic source.

suggestions.text: Escalate Marwan extension to close this week — zero paid budget can be reactivated the same day contract is signed.
